trays.notes: Set paper type to 'Pre-Printed'. Load in REVERSE orientation per Sharp manual — print side faces opposite from plain paper.

trays.weightRange: 28 lb bond to 80 lb cover (105-216 gsm) MAXIMUM
trays.notes: ONLY source rated for card stock. Paper drawers CANNOT feed scorecards. Set panel paper type to 'Heavy Paper' and register scorecard dimensions as a Custom size.

criticalLimits: Paper drawers (Trays 1-4) are rated 16-28 lb bond ONLY. Card stock in a drawer will jam and may damage the feed rollers.
Bypass tray maximum is 80 lb cover / 216 gsm. Verify scorecard stock weight before ordering.
Drawer minimum sheet size is 5.5 x 8.5 in. Bypass accepts custom sizes down to approx. 3-5/8 in on the short edge.
Load one heavy sheet at a time if misfeeds occur.

driverLinks.label: Sharp Official Product Downloads (search MX-B476W)
driverLinks.notes: Select Windows 11 64-bit, PCL6 driver. Run setup.exe as Administrator.

setupSteps: Connect Ethernet from printer rear RJ-45 to clubhouse switch.
On the 7-inch touchscreen: Settings > Network Settings > confirm assigned IP. Set a static IP or create a DHCP reservation on the router.
Download the PCL6 driver from the Sharp link above. Extract the .zip. Run setup.exe as Administrator.
Choose 'Specify address' and enter the printer IP. Port should resolve to Raw TCP 9100.
After install: Printer Properties > Configuration tab > confirm installed paper drawers match the physical machine so tray selection works.
In driver Printing Preferences, create saved presets: 'Plain', 'Checks', and 'Scorecards' with the correct tray and paper type locked in.
scorecardPrinting: Load max 50 sheets into the bypass tray, print side DOWN.
On the panel, set Bypass paper type = Heavy Paper, size = registered Custom scorecard size.
In the print dialog, set Paper Source = Bypass, Paper Type = Heavy Paper, and Output Size = the matching Custom Paper dimensions. Panel and driver settings must match or the job will hold.
Duplex is not recommended on heavy stock. Print single-sided.
Remove sheets from the output tray as they print to prevent curl.
